thread:
Ravi (partnerships): Heads-up: Newton Labs preview week set for Jun 2. Need final NDA, customs docs, and benchmark acceptance criteria by Monday. Who can own the bench sign-off? cc @Elle @Carlos @Anu
Elle (partner-ops): I'll handle shipping and customs paperwork. Carrier said ETA Thu night. Need power draw and rack U from HW.
Carlos (hw-eng): Rack footprint is 1U per node, 3 nodes total. Power: 1.2kW sustained, 2kW peak per rack. Firmware image tags: nl-2026-05-15/v2 and nl-2026-05-22/v3 (v3 has perf fixes).
Anu (bench): I'll own bench validation. Proposed test matrix: latency single-stream (seq=4096), throughput batch4 (tokens/sec), and a lightweight quality sweep vs redwood/v1.2. Also add a long-run stability 24h soak.
Ravi (partnerships): Acceptance criteria = within 10% p99 of our baseline and no quality regressions >1% on eval set. If not met, we trigger root-cause with partner.
Lee (legal): I'll review partner NDA today. We should ensure telemetry restrictions and embargo period are explicit. Also request partner indemnity clause for hardware failures in our lab.
WebhookBot: Reminder: "Newton Preview Week - Jun 2" calendar invite created for Ravi, Elle, Carlos, Anu, Lee.
Anu (bench): Quick infra note: please enable metrics export to our S3 bucket and grant write creds to bench@redwood. Sample run command:
```
./bench_runner --model redwood/v1.2 --seq 4096 --batch 1 --out s3://redwood-bench/newton/metrics.json
```
We'll collect p50/p95/p99, token-level timings, and perf traces.
Carlos (hw-eng): If partner units arrive with v2 we should run a baseline then upgrade to v3 and diff. Will capture kernel & driver versions. Also will test PCIe lane mapping since board pairing differs from our standard.
Elle (partner-ops): Shipping labels attached. I uploaded commercial invoice and HTS codes to the shared drive. ETA confirmation: Thu 22:00.
Ravi (partnerships): Can someone draft a one-pager for the partner feedback loop? Need sections: perf summary, infra issues, firmware notes, action items with owners, and go/no-go recommendation.
Anu (bench): I'll draft the feedback one-pager and include charts (latency distribution, throughput curves) and a short checklist for triage.
Lee (legal): NDA sent to partner counsel with redlines on telemetry and embargo. Asked for signed copy by Tue EOD.
Ravi (partnerships): Marketing asked to hold public comms until bench + legal sign-off. We'll treat this as embargoed.
Carlos (hw-eng): Heads-up: if we see unstable PCIe enumeration on v3, might need partner engineering onsite access. Could slow the schedule.
Elle (partner-ops): Noted. I'll check if partner can provide remote engineering support window during Wed/Fri.
Anu (bench): One more blocker to flag: quantization path in v3 changes kernel scheduling; will include a micro-benchmark to isolate token timing differences.
Ravi (partnerships): Great. Action items: Lee - NDA signed by Tue; Elle - shipping + customs by Thu; Carlos - firmware validation + PCIe checks by Fri; Anu - bench doc + runner readiness by Mon. I'll convene a day-zero standup Mon morning.
Elle (partner-ops): Will share tracking and rack slot by EOD.
Lee (legal): Received partner confirmation on NDA timeline. Attaching telemetry spec in drive now.
Anu (bench): Uploading bench doc draft and perf runner to the drive. Link coming in next message.
Ravi (partnerships): Thanks team. Keeping thread for coordination and day-zero notes. :white_check_mark:
